subject: Walkling Court Rezoning and Municipal Election Review
overview: The Council approved a major zoning amendment for the redevelopment of Walkling Court into 238 units of affordable housing and held a contentious review of the 2023 municipal election performance. They also advanced compliance measures for MBTA Communities housing mandates and accepted substantial grants for Carr Park renovations.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the Medford City Council meeting records from October 24, 2023.

items.title: National Grid Grant of Location - Main Street
items.summary: Approved a petition from National Grid to replace collapsed underground conduits on Main Street, amended to require equivalent curb-to-curb paving in an alternate city location and a police safety review.

items.title: 2023 Municipal Election Performance Review
items.summary: Approved resolutions demanding a report on procedural errors during the 2023 election, including misprinted ballots and counting delays, and authorized a letter to the Secretary of State requesting an audit.

items.title: Walkling Court Rezoning and PDD Amendment
items.summary: Approved a zoning map amendment to establish a Planned Development District (PDD) for 1-20 Walkling Court, enabling a 238-unit affordable housing redevelopment despite neighbor concerns regarding height and density.

items.title: MBTA Communities Multifamily Overlay District
items.summary: Referred the proposed Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District to the Community Development Board to comply with state transit-oriented housing mandates by year-end.

items.title: Carr Park Phase II Grant and ARPA Funding
items.summary: Approved the first reading of a $1 million loan order and a resolution to accept $2.5 million in state and federal grants for park improvements, including a new splash pad and solar-powered basketball courts.

items.title: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposal to regulate the feeding of wildlife in residential areas to the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules.

items.title: Transgender Day of Remembrance
items.summary: Passed a resolution recognizing November 20, 2023, to honor victims of anti-transgender violence and reaffirming the rights of the transgender community.

items.title: Commercial Pet Breeding Sales Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance regulating the retail sale of animals from commercial breeding facilities to the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules.

items.title: Specialized Stretch Energy Code
items.summary: Approved the third reading and final adoption of the state's specialized green building energy code.
